sunoData.title: Ashen Passage
sunoData.tags: Dark ambient game music with slow evolving drones, sparse sub pulses, and irregular metallic creaks; the arrangement begins as a thin fog of low strings and cracked synth air, then adds distant choir-like textures, reversed swells, and trembling harmonic clusters for tension peaks before sinking back into near-silence. Cold room-tone washes, occasional bell-like fragments, and granular noise transitions heighten dread. Wide, shadowy mix with deep sub pressure and a polished cinematic sheen., ambient
